column3: Before the statue of the Aeon, you hear Aeolus’s voice once again. He tells you that this offering awakened Him, but that it was not truly an offering to an Aeon—rather, it was an Aniimo returning herself to the land out of the purest love. Recognized by the land, Irelia has truly become a Guardian, and one day she will awaken again among the blossoms.
